failures.question: 2002 年 9 月的门店营业额是多少？保留两位小数。

input.sql: select count(*) as total_rows, count(d_date_sk) as matched_rows from store_sales left join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk

select sum(ss_net_paid) as value, count(*) as rows_cnt
from store_sales
join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
where date_dim.d_year = 2002 and date_dim.d_moy = 9

select min(s.ss_sold_date_sk) as min_sk, max(s.ss_sold_date_sk) as max_sk, count(*) as cnt
from store_sales s left join date_dim d on s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
where d.d_date_sk is null
select min(d_date_sk), max(d_date_sk), count(*) from date_dim
select min(d_date_sk) as min_sk, max(d_date_sk) as max_sk, min(d_date::text) as min_date, max(d_date::text) as max_date, count(*) as cnt from date_dim where d_year=2002 and d_moy=9

select s.ss_sold_date_sk, count(*) as cnt, sum(s.ss_net_paid) as amt
from store_sales s left join date_dim d on s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
where d.d_date_sk is null
group by s.ss_sold_date_sk
order by s.ss_sold_date_sk
limit 50

with bad as (
  select * from store_sales where ss_sold_date_sk between 20020901 and 20020930
), good as (
  select s.* from store_sales s join date_dim d on s.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk where d.d_year=2002 and d.d_moy=9
)
select
 (select count(*) from bad) as bad_cnt,
 (select count(*) from good) as good_cnt,
 (select count(*) from bad b join good g on b.ss_ticket_number=g.ss_ticket_number and b.ss_item_sk=g.ss_item_sk) as key_overlap,
 (select count(*) from bad b join good g on b.ss_ticket_number=g.ss_ticket_number and b.ss_item_sk=g.ss_item_sk and b.ss_net_paid=g.ss_net_paid) as full_overlap,
 (select sum(ss_net_paid) from bad) as bad_amt

with bad as (
  select to_char(ss_sold_date_sk::text::date,'YYYY-MM-DD') as day, ss_net_paid from store_sales where ss_sold_date_sk between 20020901 and 20020930
), good as (
  select d.d_date::text as day, s.ss_net_paid from store_sales s join date_dim d on s.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk where d.d_year=2002 and d.d_moy=9
)
select b.day, b.s as bad_sum, g.s as good_sum, b.c as bad_cnt, g.c as good_cnt
from (select day, sum(ss_net_paid) s, count(*) c from bad group by day) b
full join (select day, sum(ss_net_paid) s, count(*) c from good group by day) g using (day)
order by b.day limit 40

failures.question: 2002 年 9 月的门店退货率是多少？保留两位小数。

input.sql:
select count(*) as n_total,
       count(d.d_date_sk) as n_join,
       round(100.0*(count(*)-count(d.d_date_sk))/count(*),4) as loss_pct
from store_sales s left join date_dim d on s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk

select s.ss_sold_date_sk, count(*) as cnt, min(s.ss_sold_date_sk) , max(s.ss_sold_date_sk)
from store_sales s left join date_dim d on s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
where d.d_date_sk is null
group by 1 order by cnt desc limit 50
select count(*) as n, min(d_date_sk), max(d_date_sk) from date_dim where d_year=2002 and d_moy=9

select (ss_sold_date_sk >= 1000000) as big_key, (ss_sold_date_sk is null) as is_null, count(*) as cnt, min(ss_sold_date_sk), max(ss_sold_date_sk)
from store_sales group by 1,2 order by cnt desc

select
  (select count(*) from store_sales where ss_sold_date_sk between 975 and 1004) as seq_sep_cnt,
  (select count(*) from store_sales where ss_sold_date_sk between 20020901 and 20020930) as ymd_sep_cnt,
  (select count(*) from store_sales a join store_sales b on a.ss_ticket_number=b.ss_ticket_number and a.ss_item_sk=b.ss_item_sk
     where a.ss_sold_date_sk between 975 and 1004 and b.ss_sold_date_sk between 20020901 and 20020930) as dup_pairs

select 'seq' as src, count(*) cnt, count(distinct ss_ticket_number) tix, min(ss_ticket_number), max(ss_ticket_number), sum(ss_net_paid) amt, sum(ss_quantity) qty
from store_sales where ss_sold_date_sk between 975 and 1004
union all
select 'ymd', count(*), count(distinct ss_ticket_number), min(ss_ticket_number), max(ss_ticket_number), sum(ss_net_paid), sum(ss_quantity)
from store_sales where ss_sold_date_sk between 20020901 and 20020930

select
 (select count(*) from store_returns where sr_ticket_number >= 1000000000) as ret_big_tix,
 (select count(*) from store_returns) as ret_total,
 (select count(*) from store_returns where sr_return_amt is null) as null_amt

with sep as (
  select ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk, ss_net_paid
  from store_sales
  join date_dim d on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  where d.d_year = 2002 and d.d_moy = 9
)
select sum(r.sr_return_amt) as ret_amt,
       sum(s.ss_net_paid) as net_paid,
       count(*) as cnt,
       sum(r.sr_return_amt)/sum(s.ss_net_paid)*100 as rate
from sep s
left join store_returns r
  on s.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number and s.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk
select count(*) - count(distinct (sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk)) as dup_keys from store_returns

failures.question: 2002 年 9 月的电子品类门店营业额是多少？保留两位小数。

input.sql:
select count(*) as total_rows,
       count(*) filter (where ss_sold_date_sk is null) as null_date_key,
       min(ss_sold_date_sk) as min_key,
       max(ss_sold_date_sk) as max_key,
       count(*) filter (where ss_sold_date_sk < 1 or ss_sold_date_sk > 1096) as out_of_range_key,
       count(*) filter (where ss_is_current = 1) as current_rows
from store_sales

select
  count(*) as left_rows,
  count(d.d_date_sk) as matched_rows,
  count(*) filter (where d.d_date_sk is null and s.ss_sold_date_sk is not null) as unmatched_nonnull,
  count(*) filter (where s.ss_sold_date_sk is null) as null_keys
from store_sales s
left join date_dim d on s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk

select d_year, d_moy, count(*) as rows, sum(ss_net_paid) as net_paid
from store_sales s
join date_dim d on s.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk
where d.d_year=2002 and d.d_moy=9
group by d_year,d_moy

select ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk, count(*) as cnt, count(distinct ss_sold_date_sk) as date_cnt, count(distinct ss_net_paid) as amt_cnt
from store_sales
group by ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk
having count(*) > 1
limit 20

select case when ss_sold_date_sk is null then 'null'
            when ss_sold_date_sk between 1 and 1096 then 'sequential'
            when ss_sold_date_sk between 20000101 and 20021231 then 'yyyymmdd'
            else 'other' end as key_type,
       count(*) as rows,
       count(distinct ss_ticket_number) as tickets,
       min(ss_ticket_number) as min_ticket,
       max(ss_ticket_number) as max_ticket,
       min(ss_sold_date_sk) as min_key,
       max(ss_sold_date_sk) as max_key,
       sum(ss_net_paid) as net_paid
from store_sales
group by 1
order by 1

select s.*
from store_sales s
where s.ss_sold_date_sk between 20020901 and 20020930
order by s.ss_sold_date_sk, s.ss_ticket_number, s.ss_item_sk
limit 5

select s.*
from store_sales s
join date_dim d on s.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk
where d.d_year=2002 and d.d_moy=9
order by s.ss_sold_date_sk, s.ss_ticket_number, s.ss_item_sk
limit 5

select case when ss_sold_date_sk between 1 and 1096 then 'sequential' when ss_sold_date_sk between 20000101 and 20021231 then 'yyyymmdd' else 'other' end as key_type,
       count(*) as rows,
       sum(ss_net_paid) as net_paid,
       sum(case when i.i_category='电子' then 1 else 0 end) as elec_rows,
       sum(case when i.i_category='电子' then ss_net_paid else 0 end) as elec_net_paid
from store_sales s join item i on s.ss_item_sk=i.i_item_sk
group by 1 order by 1

select sum(s.ss_net_paid) as elec_net_paid,
       count(*) as rows,
       count(distinct s.ss_ticket_number) as tickets
from store_sales s
join date_dim d on s.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk
join item i on s.ss_item_sk=i.i_item_sk
where d.d_year=2002 and d.d_moy=9 and i.i_category='电子'

select count(*) as ymd_rows,
       count(g.ss_ticket_number) as matched_canonical_rows,
       count(*) filter (where g.ss_ticket_number is not null
         and g.ss_item_sk=b.ss_item_sk
         and g.ss_quantity=b.ss_quantity
         and g.ss_sales_price=b.ss_sales_price
         and g.ss_ext_sales_price=b.ss_ext_sales_price
         and g.ss_ext_discount_amt=b.ss_ext_discount_amt
         and g.ss_net_paid=b.ss_net_paid
         and g.ss_net_paid_inc_tax=b.ss_net_paid_inc_tax
         and g.ss_net_profit=b.ss_net_profit) as exact_value_matches
from store_sales b
left join store_sales g
  on b.ss_ticket_number = g.ss_ticket_number + 1000000000
 and b.ss_item_sk = g.ss_item_sk
where b.ss_sold_date_sk between 20020901 and 20020930

select count(*) as null_rows,
       count(g.ss_ticket_number) as same_ticket_item_matches,
       count(*) filter (where g.ss_ticket_number is not null
         and g.ss_quantity=n.ss_quantity
         and g.ss_sales_price=n.ss_sales_price
         and g.ss_ext_sales_price=n.ss_ext_sales_price
         and g.ss_ext_discount_amt=n.ss_ext_discount_amt
         and g.ss_net_paid=n.ss_net_paid
         and g.ss_net_paid_inc_tax=n.ss_net_paid_inc_tax
         and g.ss_net_profit=n.ss_net_profit) as exact_value_matches
from store_sales n
left join store_sales g
  on n.ss_ticket_number = g.ss_ticket_number
 and n.ss_item_sk = g.ss_item_sk
where n.ss_sold_date_sk is null

select count(*) as ymd_rows,
       count(*) filter (where g.ss_ticket_number is not null) as matched
from store_sales b
left join store_sales g
  on b.ss_ticket_number = g.ss_ticket_number + 1000000000
 and b.ss_item_sk = g.ss_item_sk
 and b.ss_quantity = g.ss_quantity
 and b.ss_sales_price = g.ss_sales_price
 and b.ss_ext_sales_price = g.ss_ext_sales_price
 and b.ss_ext_discount_amt = g.ss_ext_discount_amt
 and b.ss_net_paid = g.ss_net_paid
 and b.ss_net_paid_inc_tax = g.ss_net_paid_inc_tax
 and b.ss_net_profit = g.ss_net_profit
where b.ss_sold_date_sk between 20020901 and 20020930

input.sql: select count(*) as rows, count(distinct (l_orderkey, l_linenumber)) as distinct_keys from lineitem where l_shipdate >= date '1997-09-01' and l_shipdate < date '1997-10-01'
select round(sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)), 2) as v from lineitem where l_shipdate >= date '1997-09-01' and l_shipdate < date '1997-10-01'
select count(*) as total_rows, count(distinct (l_orderkey,l_linenumber)) as distinct_rows, min(l_shipdate) as mn, max(l_shipdate) as mx from lineitem

select count(*) as grp_cnt, sum(c) as total_rows from (select l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, count(*) as c from lineitem group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 having count(*) > 1) t

select min(l_shipdate) as mn, max(l_shipdate) as mx, count(*) as rows_with_dup_linenum from (
 select l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate,
        count(*) as c, count(distinct l_linenumber) as dln
 from lineitem group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 having count(*)>1) t
